premises.text: Mobile invoicing was not being properly addressed by existing invoice solutions
premises.evidence_span: basically felt that the mobile aspect of it was not being properly addressed

premises.text: A cloud-powered tool manages the entire business from one consistent mobile interface
premises.evidence_span: a fully integrated cloud-powered business management tool with a consistent user interface on all mobile operating systems

premises.text: Launch integrations cover QuickBooks, QuickBooks Online, and Xero, with further B2B platforms reaching about 300,000 companies
premises.evidence_span: our integrations with Soho OS, Xero, and TradeShift will reach about 300,000 companies

premises.text: A lack of documentation in mobile invoicing is answered with picture, audio, and geotag attachments
premises.evidence_span: a lack of documentation, not just in normal invoicing, but in mobile invoicing

premises.text: Saved invoices sync instantly to the cloud, archive, and write through to connected platforms
premises.evidence_span: When you save this, it instantly jumps to our cloud, archives all the data, and if it's connected to another platform, it will write it

premises.text: The invoice URL comes back to the device immediately and can be emailed to the customer
premises.evidence_span: It's going to create and send a URL back to the device. And that URL can be viewed immediately

premises.text: Freemium pricing gates storage, payments, and platform attach behind $7 and $10 monthly tiers
premises.evidence_span: To activate the data storage and enable payment, we ask $7 a month per user. And to to attach to accounting or to another B2B platform, it's $10
